operating_income.source: Operating income not reported in XBRL (null). Proxy = pretax income (us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxes...) + us-gaap:InterestExpense: FY23 52783+849, FY24 48873+996, FY25 41268+603; accession 0000034088-26-000045. Includes equity income; reviewer should verify.

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 revenue fell 5.0%; flat commodity-price deck in 2026, then growth near inflation/volume growth of ~2%.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: proxy EBIT margin was 15.6%/14.3%/12.6% in FY23-25; hold ~13%, near FY25 level with modest mean reversion.

tax_rate.source: Damodaran US Oil/Gas (Integrated) effective tax rate 28.2% (dataset 2026-01-05).

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 capex 28,358 / revenue 332,238 = 8.5%; consistent with growing capex program.

wacc.source: Assumption. CAPM check: rf 4.86% (US 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta ~0.31 (Damodaran unlevered cash-corrected 0.278, D/E 0.138, tax 25%) x ERP 4.46% = ~6.2% Ke; Damodaran industry WACC 5.1%. Rounded up to 7.5% as the industry beta looks low (4 firms) for a cyclical commodity producer.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run inflation-like growth, below the 4.86% risk-free rate; energy transition caps higher growth.

net_debt.source: deskstack derived: total debt 43,537 (LT 34,241 + current 9,296) - cash 10,681; no short-term investments reported; accession 0000034088-26-000045

diluted_shares.source: Weighted diluted shares not reported in the data (null). Derived = net income 28,844M / diluted EPS 6.70 = ~4,305M; approximate, verify against the 10-K. Cover-page shares 4,144.9M at 2026-03-31.
